result.text: We need an extensive architectural security review of our session authentication subsystems before next month's audit. Look at token_verifier.ts in the authentication directory and check file reference security.json in the configuration folder. In addition inspect session.py in the models package to audit how cryptographic tokens are stored and refreshed. The authentication middleware currently decodes JSON Web Tokens without checking token expiration timestamps during key rotation. Update token_verifier.ts to validate token signatures against our public JWKS endpoint with 5-minute caching. In security.json verify that maximum session duration is set to 24 hours and idle timeout is 8 hours. session.py must implement automatic session revocation when users change passwords or update multi-factor authentication methods. Tag session.py to ensure that database queries utilize prepared statements to prevent SQL injection vulnerabilities. The security compliance team requires that all audit logs record client IP address, user agent, and session identifier. Under no circumstances should plaintext session tokens be written to application log files or diagnostic traces. Furthermore review rate_limiter.ts in middleware to confirm that failed login requests trigger sliding window rate limiting. Tag crypto.ts in utils to inspect how refresh tokens are hashed using SHA-256 before persistence in database records. The penetration testing report identified that cookie headers lack the SAME_STRIKE and SECURE attributes on staging. In addition verify that cross-origin resource sharing policies defined in cors.json restrict access exclusively to trusted internal domain origins. The compliance director confirmed that any critical authentication vulnerabilities must be remediated within 48 hours of discovery. Site reliability engineers must instrument OpenTelemetry spans tracking token verification latency and error distributions. Check that Redis connection timeouts during token blacklisting lookups fail securely by denying access rather than allowing bypass. The mobile client team must also ensure that biometric authentication tokens are validated against device hardware keystores. Security leads require automated regression tests verifying that brute-force credential stuffing attempts trigger account locking after 10 consecutive failures. In addition review auth_handler.ts in auth to verify that OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow enforces PKCE with SHA-256 code challenges. Confirm that client secrets are never bundled into frontend static JavaScript builds or exposed via public SSR bundles. The infrastructure security group must verify that TLS 1.3 is enforced across all ingress endpoints with HSTS preloading enabled. Finally establish automated integration test cases verifying that expired tokens return HTTP 401 Unauthorized and that rate limiting thresholds enforce 30 invalid authentication attempts per minute per IP address before blocking.
